tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Net worth, balance sheet and current holdings, in the ledger's base currency.

tools.name: get_net_worth_history
tools.description: Historical net-worth snapshots (one point per day where recorded).

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: Transaction history as a human-friendly list, newest first.

tools.name: get_reference_data
tools.description: Valid accounts, providers, tickers, asset classes and categories. Also base_currency, the currency every amount is stated in. Read this before writing: trades and adjustments must use these values unless allow_new_values is set.

tools.name: get_tax_report
tools.description: Capital-gains / income tax estimate for a year: gains, losses, exemption (including any carried-forward amount), taxable base and estimated tax.

tools.name: get_projection_config
tools.description: The forecast/FIRE plan's assumptions (salary, expenses, inflation, retirement dates, tax mode). The projection itself is computed client-side.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Current price per ticker with its source, quote currency and recent change, plus any manual overrides.

tools.name: refresh_prices
tools.description: Fetch fresh market prices now. With no ticker this refreshes every priced holding; with one it refreshes just that ticker.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: Linked exchange, bank and wallet connections, each with its sync mode (balance updates, or transactions staged for review) and when it last synced.

tools.name: sync_connections
tools.description: Sync every linked connection in one pass: push the latest balance into each linked holding, and stage new transactions into the review queue. Reports what was written, what was staged and any per-provider errors.

tools.name: log_trade
tools.description: Log a trade (buy / sell / swap), expressed as from-asset to to-asset. Same body and validation as POST /api/transactions.

tools.name: record_balance_adjustment
tools.description: Record a signed quantity change on one holding (a balance update that is not a trade). Same body and validation as POST /api/position-adjustments.

tools.name: propose_holdings_import
tools.description: Prepare an import of what the user owns and owes: one row per current holding, not their transaction history. Saves a draft only. Nothing is added until the user reviews and imports it in Krosos, so this works on a read-only connection. asset is one of the asset classes in get_reference_data. Amount

tools.name: propose_net_worth_history_import
tools.description: Prepare an import of the user's past net worth: one total per date, from old statements or another tracker's export. Saves a draft only. Nothing is added until the user reviews and imports it in Krosos, so this works on a read-only connection. total_value_eur is the whole net worth that day in base_

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_connections, propose_holdings_import, propose_net_worth_history_import · Private data: list_connections, record_balance_adjustment · Public sink: get_tax_report, log_trade, record_balance_adjustment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_connections, propose_holdings_import, propose_net_worth_history_import · Private data: list_connections, record_balance_adjustment · Public sink: get_tax_report, log_trade, record_balance_adjustment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_reference_data" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Valid accounts, providers, tickers, asset classes and categories. Read this before writing: trades and adjustments must use these values unless allow_new_values is set." → after: "Valid accounts, providers, tickers, asset classes and categories. Also base_currency, the currency every amount is stated in. Read this before writing: trades and adjustments must use these values unless allow_new_values is set."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
